column3: TextKey
BREAK
AHHHHHHH!
Oh-- It's you! You have to stop scaring the feathers off me!
Almost ruined my hiding spot as well!! Those humans over there knocked the plumage off me!
Did you know that legend says we once helped humans? Carried mail thousands of kilometers for them!
We were heroes! Sky messengers! Tiny feathery delivery legends!
Sounds crazy. I know. Now they mostly just chase and yell at us. Soo SCARY! Humans are unpredictable.
They tend to throw things..kick.. or chase you if they spot you. So when you wanna be invisible… you gotta sneak.
Hold down LEFT CTRL OR LEFT BUMPER and move slowly. Stay behind stuff. Boxes. Benches. Fences. Decorative shrubbery.
To sprint hold down the LEFT SHIFT OR L3.  It will take you out of the stealth mode so be speedy!!  If you see something you want… snatch it up with F.
Feeling confident?  I need some help. I’ve lost my ..hat… in the theater! And it’s crowded with people!
It’s actually my night light. A jar of fireflies. I can’t sleep without it.
YOU WILL?! Oh thank goodness. Okay okay. Sneak past the humans.Use objects for cover. If they see you… you better move those little feet!
Oh. That’s okay. Totally fine. I’ll just…Never sleep again. We can practice sneaking more. That’s good. I like practice. Practice is safe.
Just kidding. I NEED my nightlight. NOW!
YOU DID IT!!! You’re the bravest bird I know. Which is not a high bar but still!!
OMG! HI!! You’re here!! Okay okay okay don’t freak out but I found the BEST stuff!!
It was in a garbage can!! Which means it’s premium.
Okay so like — see shiny? Or crunchy? Or vaguely food-shaped? You can pick it up! Just press F OR Y to grab it.
YES!! Put it in your wingventory! That’s your treasure pocket! Press I OR UP DIRECTION PAD to check out what you got.
Now here’s the IMPORTANT part. Use LEFT CLICK OR RIGHT TRIGGER to poop on those pesky humans! And RIGHT CLICK OR LEFT TRIGGER to aim so you waste less!
When your poop meter gets low? You gotta eat. Garbage snacks fill it back up. Nature is BEAUTIFUL.
Garbage cans are like mystery boxes! Use E OR X BUTTON to interact! You never know what you’ll get!
Maybe fries. Maybe bread. Maybe something that builds character. If it wiggles.. maybe don’t.
Hey there little man!! You ready to learn some sick moves?
Relax your feathers. The sky’s chill. It only looks big. Okay yeah it’s massive. But you’ll be fine.
You know the basics but you want more! First thing? Lift off.
Use WASD OR RIGHT STICK that Birdadette taught to control where you’re flying to. Don’t fight the wind — vibe with it.
Release you’re flight button and just glide on down. Flying fast is easy. Flying cool? That’s skill.
Now bring it in. Wanna dive down quickly? Use Q. Maybe a softer approach? Hover with G or just glide on down.
Last move. Perch. Spots you can perchwill have a handy little symbol letting you know it’s a chill hang spot. Line up slow. Feet forward. Let it catch you. Press E when you see that icon!
Now let's see you put it all together. Look for race posters like the one on this sign and test your wings! Show me what you got!
hello young one! you look like you dont know anything about anything

column3: All my flo-
ANYWAYYY *Didn't ask your whole life story here*
I have this old nest in the park up here if you want it? It's a fixer-upper but still....good.
Alright
GREAT! Follow me to your newww home!
Are pigeon nest supposed to look that....bad?
Back in my day we would sleep on spikes and be HAPPY. *scoff*...Okay maybe you could spruce it up with 3 more sticks to make it cozier.
Try heading EAST to the most popular park in town. There's bounmd to be sticks there.
Buuuuttttttttt..... you MIGHT want to sneak into the park using "LEFT CTRL"...whatever that means...
HEY!!
I thought you were supposed to sneak?!
YOU have to sneak.... I can do whatever I want.
Anyway, looks like that dog has a pretty good stick! You can pick up that ball using "E" and use it to distract that dog...
Woah. I didn't think you'd live...
I mean....GREAT JOB KID!
What are you waiting for?! Go build that nest!
Now you got a nice nest, better name it something nice as well
you know if you wanted to do a favor for this old bird, you could ruin that humans day for me. they're the ones who ruined this archetectural marvel of a nest ... you know before it was yours
I mean...sure

Also, I know youre new to this whole "bird" thing, but everybody knows us for pooping everywhere. But you need to fill up your tank first! Try eating some bread and see what happens, i know weirdos like to throw out perfectly good food so check out the garbage
Since you're all fulled up now, go test you aim on that human over there. ya the one whose always chasing this delicate lady around
YOU NAILED THAT GUY GOOD!
Now I say this because I care.... But you look.... weak.
I doubt you could fly on top of a building even if you tried...
Since you're such a wimp, try using that manhole for a boost so you have a better chance of getting to the top of that building, a great place to hid from angry humans!
ah that brings this old soul some joy, now there are probably other destoryed or abandoned nests all over this city (housing crisis my feathers) I'm sure no one would bat a wing at you fixing them up
OH! Before I go, I think I saw somebirdy that looked JUST like you... Only more handsome...
They were NORTH of here. If you find them, tell them Birdbooshka wants to peck together sometime
Ew
HEY!! HEY COO!!
Do I know you?
Nope.
BUT has anybirdy told you that you look JUST like the new neighbours that got blown in recently?!
Actually yes! Can you tell me more about them!?
...for free?
...yes?
Nah, but if you get me this bread from a famous cafe EAST of here I'd tell you?
Can't you do it yourself?
... I get by with a little help from my friends?
...fine.
Well... Here's your fancy bread
Egg-celent! Thanks a ton stranger!
Can I know about those neighbours now?
I mean...I didn't actually TALK to them. BUT I did see one hit a roof pretty hard when he missed the first building!
He landed on this tall orange building SOUTHEAST of here. I think it was between 2 blue buildings?
Anyway, leave me alone now. I'm about to taste heaven!
OH HEY! I know you!
You totally grew up little dude!
Hey now that we're back together can you do me a solid?
I hurt my wing pretty bad trying to do a backflip onto this roof and I can't find the others... Can I crash at your nest while you go find them?
...a backflip...? I mean , yeah, sure.
AYEEE! Thanks little dude I owe you one! I think I heard something about somebirdy somewhere south of here? It might be worth a look?
Very helpful...okay.
I SAY, My good fellow!
You look young and sprightly, tough enough to scare a dog or two...or SIX!
Mind helping an old chap like myself with a dilemma?
Uhhh. I'm a bit busy-
EXCELLENT my dear bird! Thank you so much for agreeing!
You see, A pack of mongrels have teken a liking to my favorite alleyway. They have the finest bread here you see...
Not too moldy... but just enough to add some flavor!
Anywho, those brutes have kept me out even though I put up quite the fight you see, and I can't enjoy my favorite snack anymore.
Give them a good poo in the eye! THAT oughta teach them a lesson!
Oh, I think a young bird got stuck in there too. You look quite like her! Yes! Yes Indeed!
..but more importantly - PLEASE HELP ME GET MY SNACKS BACK!!!
Wait did you say-
Tally Ho dear friend! - Yes. Off you go!
You found me!! I was SOO scared! I thought Arnesto would come but I'm soo glad to see you!
YAHOO! Well done! Now I can eat to my hearts desire! You have made me one happy bird!
Do you know this guy?
He ran away when the dogs came yelling " EAT HER! EAT HER!"
Pish posh - Now off you go! Out of my alleyway!
I'm gone... Do you have a nest around here?
I'm going to go rest my wings after such an awful day!
Oh! Before I go, I met the strangest Fancy Crow. He might be able to help you find the others!
He usually hangs out in alleyways but be careful you don't go in the one with the cat hiding there...
Fancy Crow...?
Are you mister fancy crow?
What is it that we consider fancy? that of great craftsmenship or that which others have deamed to be so simply for being expensive?
..... ah yes I suppose I am a crow who sports a fantastical attire, how might I assist you?
i was told you might have information that can help me

within this crainum lies many avenues of knowledge, but the door to that remians tightly fassoned until you can prove your worth! fetch me a rose, dear heart, one of the deepest red and most delicate petels. i have heard rumor that ones lays upon the roof yonder
a fine sight this is, and with it a trusted companion now comes, welcome to my shop of wonders and mysteries
Once upon a midnight drea-... Ah, but you are not dreary! Nor is it midnight?
What bring you to my humble roost, traveler?
Behold these trinkets - each a relic of fortunes lost. Of whispers past! Choose wisely, for all that glitters is not gold... and some are cursed!
To trade, to barter, to deal in fate - what an exquisite folly. And yet, 'tis folly tgat keeps my feathers fluffed and my roost adorned
Trinkets, baubles, relics of yore... each with a tale, a mystery, a fate entwined. Do they call to you as they once did me?
A fair trade, is it not? Trinkets for treasures, whispers for wonders. But beware, for nevermore shall it be yours to return
You seek. Yet fortune flees. Prophet! says I, thing of evil! - Prophet still, if bird or devil! Return when your pockets jingle with fates favor
Be that word our sign of parting, bird or beast! - Take thy treasures and leave my roost. Yet, should fate beckon, return again...
Shadows stretch long in the dying light, whispering of past patrons, of trades struck, of fortunes lost...and won
Tis some pigeon tapping at my chamber door - only this, and nothing more
A traveller of the sky, burdened with purpose. Tell me, do winds whisper secrets to thee as they do to me?
On this desolate perch I linger, watching, waiting. The world turns, yet here I remain - steadfast, solemn...evermore
Since you were so looooooovely, let me give you some information. On the house...
Information?
No questions allowed. I invited a paw-sitively wonderful friend who might know what you are looking for...
Who...?
NO QUESTIONS! His name is Sir. Meowsalot who would know exactly where to look for whoooo you are missing. Look for the alleycat with a BRIGHT PINK nose
are you by chance sir.mewsalot? edgar said you might have some information for me
oh are you looking for that odd fellow whose out and about at night?
oh ya Coobert was always extra afraid of the dark
Coobert! What a fine and noble name, they seem to be in possession of a glowing jar to light their path ... perhaps follow the trail of escaped glowing lights to find them
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!! omg it's you!!! you scared the feathers off me!!!
sorry sorry!
it's good to see you but we can't stay out here! it's much to dark!!
let's head to my nest! it's nicely lit and comfortabe
Oh no, oh no, oh no! This is a full-blown feather-mergency!
They just wanted a better view of the area! Then, whoosh, a gust took him all the way up!
What is going on?
A fellow pigeon is stuck on the roof! And he was only just blown in from that horrible storm!
No wonder they're scared to fly down!
Plus I heard that there'creatures that hunt pigeons in the area! No one bird should try and dodge those villans
I can't just leave them up there alone!
It would take a brave bird to manage those skys! Make sure you load up on snacks before taking flight
Ruffle! Are you there?
oh my!!! are you trapped up here as well????
no no I'm hear to get you down! but we need to be carful to avoid the hawk
i wasn't sure if i was gonna make it out of that one! thanks for the slick save
i'm glad i swooped in in time!
man i really need a good nap .. in a covered area this time!!
you should head over to my nest! you can rest up with some other flock memebers I've found
OMG YOU DID IT!!! YOU FOUND EVERYONE!!
Never a doubt in my mind short stuff!
The bravest out of all the birds!
Thank goodness we can all brave the dark together again!
